## Final continuity sweep

- [ ] Every wound persists or heals with stated cause and time
- [ ] Every named object has continuous custody
- [ ] Every power use is legal at that chapter
- [ ] Every character acts only on available information
- [ ] Every count, age, date, distance, and deadline matches
- [ ] Day/night, travel, and scene order are physically possible
- [ ] Supporting characters retain agency and consequences
- [ ] Source and localized editions agree on facts and deliberate ambiguity
